title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 22: a good name, training up a child, and warnings about the poor and the hot-tempered.

questions.text: According to the first verse, what is more desirable than great riches?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:1 says a good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

questions.text: What do the rich and the poor have in common, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:2 says the rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.

answers.text: Yahweh is the maker of them all

questions.text: What does this chapter say will happen if you train up a child in the way he should go?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:6 says train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

answers.text: He will become rich and honored
He will serve kings all his days
He will honor his father and mother
When he is old he will not depart from it

questions.text: According to this chapter, the borrower is servant to whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:7 says the rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

questions.text: What happens when you drive out the mocker, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:10 says drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; quarrels and insults will stop.

questions.text: What excuse does the sluggard give in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:13 says the sluggard says, "There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!"

questions.text: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; what drives it far from him?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:15 says folly is bound up in the heart of a child, and the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

questions.text: Whom does this chapter say you should not befriend?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:24 says don't befriend a hot-tempered man, and don't associate with one who harbors anger, lest you learn his ways.

questions.text: What does this chapter say you must not move?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:28 says don't move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

questions.text: Whom will a man skilled in his work serve, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:29 says do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings; he won't serve obscure men.
